findings.description: Preliminary plans have been filed to expand the existing three-storey structure at 445 19th Avenue in the Central Richmond into the rear yard and add a fourth floor, more than doubling the floor area from 3,490 to 8,330 square feet and doubling the residential capacity to four units — one one-bedroom, one two-bedroom and two three-bedrooms — with parking for four cars and an enlarged ground-floor garage. Caha Design Group drew the plans and Hatch Projects LLC is the property owner. Construction is estimated to start in summer 2027, to last ten to fourteen months, and to cost about $1.8 million, a figure the outlet says excludes other development costs. The work is proposed, not built, so nothing goes into the building block.

citation.label: San Francisco YIMBY, “Preliminary Permits For 445 19th Avenue, Central Richmond, San Francisco,” 4 September 2026

raw.text: Preliminary plans have been filed for additional housing at 445 19th Avenue in San Francisco’s Central Richmond District. The infill would expand the existing structure to double the residential capacity. Hatch Projects LLC is the property owner and is responsible for the project.

findings.note: The article contradicts itself about the street: the headline, the renderings' captions and the lede all say 445 19th Avenue, but one later sentence says 'The property is located along 18th Avenue between Geary Boulevard and Anza Street.' Taken as an error in that sentence, since 19th Avenue is what the piece says four other times, and 445 19th Avenue is between Geary and Anza.

EAS puts 443, 445 19TH AVE on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 443.

findings.description: New building permits have been filed for three apartment buildings at the Balboa Reservoir master plan across from the City College campus. Blocks C and D were filed together, adding 243 market-rate units in Type 3A over Type 1A structures at 198 Wisteria Lane; 170 Meyer Lane is a five-storey mixed-use building of 174 apartments over a podium garage. Block G, filed in June, is a 164-unit complex of 61 one-bedrooms, 89 two-bedrooms and 14 three-bedrooms with parking for 206 cars and 118 bicycles, designed by Pyatok and sponsored by AvalonBay Communities. Two affordable complexes are already under construction, 159 units at Block A and 128 at Block E, and the first phase of 288 units is expected as early as 2028. BRIDGE Housing Corporation and AvalonBay Communities lead the development with Mission Housing Development Corporation. The 1,100-unit master plan is now at 704 units in progress.

extra.developers: BRIDGE Housing Corporation; AvalonBay Communities; Mission Housing Development Corporation

citation.label: San Francisco YIMBY, “New Building Permits Filed In Balboa Reservoir Masterplan, San Francisco,” 6 September 2026

publish.note: Blocked: the seeder refuses the parcel. 198 Wisteria Lane resolves to parcel 3180214, which sf-parcels reports active but which has no row on the 2025 secured roll — seed_pages.py printed 'no 2025 roll row for 3180214 (198 Wisteria Lane) — skipped', which is the site's rule about what may become a page and it outranks the story. The second address in the story, 170 Meyer Lane, is in the same condition. Worth retrying once the buildings appear on a roll.
